body.zh-Hant: 勞合·喬治1863年1月17日生於曼徹斯特，1864年父親過世後，母親帶著孩子遷往蘭斯圖姆杜伊，與其兄弟理查·勞合同住。他1885年在克里基厄斯開始執業當律師，1888年11月獲提名為卡納芬自治市鎮的自由黨預定候選人，並在1890年4月10日的大選中當選。GOV.UK 說他1890年當選自由黨議員時年僅27歲，也是唯一以威爾斯語為母語的首相。
body.en: Lloyd George was born in Manchester on 17 January 1863. After his father died in 1864 his mother took the children to Llanystumdwy to live with her brother Richard Lloyd. He began practice as a solicitor at Criccieth in 1885, was adopted in November 1888 as prospective Liberal candidate for the Caernarfon Boroughs, and was returned at the general election of 10 April 1890. GOV.UK says he was elected Liberal MP at 27 and is the only Prime Minister whose first language was Welsh.

heading.zh-Hant: 貿易委員會、財政與軍需
heading.en: Board of Trade, the Treasury and Munitions

body.zh-Hant: 1905年自由黨上台，他出任貿易委員會主席並入閣；1908年4月阿斯奎斯接任首相，他接任財政大臣。1909年他提出首份預算，被形容為現代最具爭議的預算，上議院否決後促成1911年議會法通過。1914年8月對德宣戰時，他以財政大臣身分負責穩定國家財政；1915年5月第一屆聯合政府成立，他改任軍需大臣；1916年5月基奇納過世後，他被任命為陸軍大臣。
body.en: When the Liberals came to power in 1905 he became President of the Board of Trade with a seat in the Cabinet; in April 1908, when Asquith became Prime Minister, he succeeded him as Chancellor of the Exchequer. His first Budget in 1909 was described as the most controversial of modern times, and its rejection by the Lords led to the 1911 Parliament Act. When war was declared in August 1914 he had to stabilise the finances; in May 1915 he became Minister of Munitions, and after Kitchener died in May 1916 he was appointed Secretary for War.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年12月阿斯奎斯辭職，勞合·喬治出任首相；議會紀錄載明他自1916年12月6日起任首相，至1922年10月22日止。任內他確立了盟軍的統一指揮，1918年停戰後以聯合政府首腦身分贏得345席的多數，1919年1月18日和會開幕時，他是三位最受矚目的人物之一。GOV.UK 說他1919年簽署凡爾賽條約。1921年12月他促成愛爾蘭條約通過；1922年10月聯合政府中的保守黨議員退出，他隨即辭職。
body.en: In December 1916 Asquith resigned and Lloyd George became Prime Minister; Hansard gives 6 December 1916 to 22 October 1922. He established unity of command of the Allied forces, won a majority of 345 as head of the Coalition after the 1918 Armistice, and was one of the three most prominent figures when the Peace Conference opened on 18 January 1919. GOV.UK says he signed the Treaty of Versailles in 1919. He carried the Irish Treaty through in December 1921 and resigned in October 1922 when the Conservative members of the Coalition left.

heading.en: Years out of office and later life

body.zh-Hant: 辭職後他仍活躍於政壇，卻未再擔任官職。1926年他啟動自由黨工業調查，1934年1月在班戈發表演說，提出重建國家繁榮的「新政」；1933至1936年間他撰寫《戰爭回憶錄》，1936年8月訪問德國並會晤希特勒。1939年戰爭爆發後他未參與指揮，仍留任下議院議員，直到1945年1月辭去議席並受封伯爵；他於1945年3月26日在家中去世。
body.en: After resigning he stayed politically active but never again held office. In 1926 he set in train the Liberal Industrial Enquiry, in January 1934 he outlined his New Deal policy at Bangor, from 1933 to 1936 he wrote his War Memoirs, and in August 1936 he visited Germany and met Hitler. When war came in 1939 he took no part in its direction, remained an MP until January 1945, when he resigned his seat and was granted an earldom, and died at home on 26 March 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 張伯倫1869年3月18日生於伯明罕，是約瑟夫·張伯倫最小的兒子，同父異母的兄長奧斯丁曾任財政大臣；他就讀拉格比公學與伯明罕的梅森學院。21歲時他前往巴哈馬管理一座兩萬英畝的莊園，Cadbury 研究圖書館載明他1890至1897年經營當地的劍麻種植園。回到伯明罕後成為重要製造業者，1911年當選市議員，1915年出任市長。
body.en: Neville Chamberlain was born in Birmingham on 18 March 1869, the youngest son of Joseph Chamberlain and half-brother of Austen, a Chancellor of the Exchequer; he was educated at Rugby and Mason College. At 21 he went to the Bahamas to manage a 20,000-acre estate, and the Cadbury Research Library records that he managed the family sisal plantation there in 1890-1897. Back in Birmingham he became a leading manufacturer, was elected a councillor in 1911 and became Lord Mayor in 1915.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年勞合·喬治任命他為國民服務部總監，但兩人之間的個人嫌隙使他不到一年就辭職。GOV.UK 記他1918年當選伯明罕拉德伍德選區的保守黨議員，並拒絕在聯合政府中服務於勞合·喬治之下。1922年他在博納·勞政府出任郵政大臣；議會紀錄載明他1923年任財政大臣、1923至1929年任衛生大臣。Cadbury 研究圖書館說他在1930年被任命為保守黨主席，並協助整頓保守黨中央辦公室。
body.en: In 1916 Lloyd George appointed Chamberlain Director General of National Service, but personal bitterness between them led to his resignation within a year. GOV.UK says that in 1918 he was elected Conservative MP for Ladywood and refused to serve under Lloyd George in the coalition. In 1922 he became Postmaster General under Bonar Law; Hansard lists him as Chancellor of the Exchequer in 1923 and Minister of Health 1923-1929. The Cadbury Research Library says he was appointed chairman of the Conservative Party in 1930 and helped reorganise Conservative Central Office.

heading.en: Chancellor and succession as Prime Minister

body.zh-Hant: 1931年麥克唐納的國民政府任命他為財政大臣，鮑德溫其後也繼續留用他。議會紀錄載明他1931至1937年任財政大臣；經濟危機期間，他在1932年透過進口關稅法案實現其父的保護主義抱負。1937年5月他接替鮑德溫出任首相，議會紀錄記為5月28日，GOV.UK 說他同時獲選為保守黨黨魁。
body.en: In 1931 Ramsay MacDonald made him Chancellor in his National Government and Baldwin kept him on. Hansard lists him as Chancellor of the Exchequer 1931-1937, and in the economic crisis he passed the Import Duties Bill in 1932, achieving his father's protectionist aims. In May 1937 he succeeded Baldwin as Prime Minister (28 May in Hansard), and GOV.UK says he was also elected Conservative leader.

body.zh-Hant: 首相任內他致力於幾乎不惜代價恢復和平。1938年他在慕尼黑會見希特勒，雙方達成英德不再交戰的協議，他返國後宣稱「我相信這是我們這個時代的和平」。隔年希特勒佔領布拉格，波蘭被入侵後，他在1939年9月3日宣戰。1940年5月，英國解放挪威的行動失敗後他辭職，議會紀錄記他任期止於5月9日。他隨後罹患腸癌，1940年11月9日在漢普郡赫克菲爾德去世。
body.en: As Prime Minister he was dedicated to restoring peace at almost any price. He met Hitler at Munich in 1938 and on his return declared "I believe it is peace for our time". Hitler occupied Prague the following year, and after the invasion of Poland Chamberlain declared war on 3 September 1939. He resigned in May 1940 after the failure of the British efforts to liberate Norway; Hansard ends his term on 9 May. Bowel cancer struck soon after, and he died at Heckfield, Hampshire, on 9 November 1940.

body.zh-Hant: 威爾遜1856年12月28日生於維吉尼亞州斯湯頓，父親是長老會牧師。他在普林斯頓大學就讀三年，1879年取得學士學位，其後進入維吉尼亞大學法學院，並在喬治亞州亞特蘭大執業一年。他再進約翰·霍普金斯大學研讀歷史與政治學，1886年取得博士學位，1885年出版《國會政府》。他曾在布林莫爾學院任教三年、在衛斯理大學任教兩年，之後加入普林斯頓教職。
body.en: Wilson was born in Staunton, Virginia, on 28 December 1856, the son of a Presbyterian minister. He spent three years at Princeton, receiving his baccalaureate in 1879, then attended the University of Virginia law school and practised law for a year in Atlanta, Georgia. He entered Johns Hopkins University as a graduate student in history and political science, published Congressional Government in 1885 and earned his PhD in 1886. He taught three years at Bryn Mawr and two years at Wesleyan before joining the Princeton faculty.

heading.zh-Hant: 普林斯頓校長與新澤西州長
heading.en: Princeton president and Governor of New Jersey

body.zh-Hant: 1902至1910年他擔任普林斯頓大學校長，因主張改革教育而廣為人知；之後轉入政界，1911至1913年出任新澤西州長，再度以改革者形象受到矚目。1912年總統選舉中，塔夫脫與老羅斯福分裂了共和黨選票，威爾遜因此當選；他推動「新自由」改革，包括調整關稅與修訂銀行體系。1913年3月4日就任總統。
body.en: He was president of Princeton University from 1902 to 1910 and became widely known for his ideas on reforming education. He then entered politics and was governor of New Jersey from 1911 to 1913, again distinguishing himself as a reformer. In the 1912 presidential election Taft and Theodore Roosevelt split the Republican vote and Wilson won; he set about the New Freedom reforms, including changing the tariff and revising the banking system. He was inaugurated on 4 March 1913.

heading.en: First term and entry into the war

body.zh-Hant: 威爾遜是美國第28任總統。第一次世界大戰初期，他決心保持中立，向交戰雙方提出調停卻遭拒；1916年選民受「他讓我們置身戰外」口號影響，讓他連任。1917年情勢轉變，1月31日德國宣布無限制潛艇戰，他在4月2日向國會正式請求宣戰，4月6日國會批准。
body.en: Wilson was the 28th President. In the early days of the First World War he was determined to stay neutral and offered mediation to both sides, but was rebuffed; in 1916 the electorate, reacting to the slogan "He kept us out of war", re-elected him. In 1917 the issue of freedom of the seas forced a change: Germany announced unrestricted submarine warfare on 31 January, Wilson made the formal request for a declaration of war on 2 April, and Congress granted it on 6 April.

heading.en: Peace conference, stroke and last years

body.zh-Hant: 1918年1月8日他向國會提出「十四點」和平原則。1919年在凡爾賽召開的和會上，他促成國際聯盟盟約通過，但美國參議院拒絕批准加入聯盟；他在1919年獲諾貝爾和平獎。1919年9月25日在科羅拉多州普韋布洛演說後，他倒下並在一週後腦出血，仍完成了餘下十七個月任期，任期於1921年3月4日結束；1924年2月3日去世。
body.en: On 8 January 1918 he addressed Congress on the Fourteen Points. At the 1919 Peace Conference at Versailles he secured the adoption of the Covenant of the League of Nations, but the Senate declined to approve American acceptance; he received the 1919 Nobel Peace Prize. After a speech at Pueblo, Colorado, on 25 September 1919 he collapsed and a week later suffered a cerebral haemorrhage, yet completed the remaining seventeen months of his term, which ended on 4 March 1921; he died on 3 February 1924.
